name: qlrisk_ccr_exposure
title: Counterparty exposure
description: Counterparty credit exposure. mode='trade_profiles' simulates each trade's exposure profile from the market data: EE, PFE, effective EE (EEE), EPE, effective EPE, peak PFE and a CVA where qlrisk's product model gives one (a warning says when it does not). mode='calculator' runs a qlrisk exposure calculator from summary inputs: measure ce (current exposure, collateral-adjusted), ee, eee, pfe, peak, stressed (crisis scenarios). mode='wrong_way' measures wrong-way risk: exposure conditional on the counterparty's credit spread widening by shock_sigmas. Units: probabilities, LGDs, recoveries, rates, haircuts and volatilities in percent (pd_pct 2 = 2%), spreads in basis points (credit_spread_bp 120 = 1.2%), maturities and horizons in years, margin periods in business days; amounts in the trade currency. Calculator fields: ce: mark_to_market*, collateral_held (default 0.0), collateral_posted (default 0.0), collateral_haircut_pct (%, default 0), threshold (default 0.0), minimum_transfer_amount (default 0.0), independent_amount (default 0.0), netting_set_id, trades_in_netting_set. ee: current_mtm*, notional*, remaining_maturity_years* (years), volatility_pct* (%), product_type (default irs), interest_rate_pct (%, default 5), drift_pct (%, default 0), collateral_held (default 0.0), margin_period_of_risk_days (business days, default 10), num_simulations (default 10000), time_grid (years), exposure_paths. eee: current_mtm*, notional*, remaining_maturity_years* (years), volatility_pct* (%), product_type (default irs), interest_rate_pct (%, default 5), drift_pct (%, default 0), collateral_held (default 0.0), margin_period_of_risk_days (business days, default 10), num_simulations (default 10000), time_grid (years), exposure_paths. pfe: current_mtm*, notional*, remaining_maturity_years* (years), volatility_pct* (%), product_type (default irs), interest_rate_pct (%, default 5), fx_rate (default 1.0), credit_spread_bp (bp, default 100), collateral_held (default 0.0), margin_period_of_risk_days (business days, default 10), num_simulations (default 10000), time_grid (years), exposure_paths. peak: current_mtm*, notional*, remaining_maturity_years* (years), volatility_pct* (%), product_type (default irs), ee_profile, pfe_profile, time_grid (years), num_simulations (default 10000), confidence_pct (%, default 95), collateral_held (default 0.0). stressed: current_mtm*, notional*, remaining_maturity_years* (years), volatility_pct* (%), product_type (default irs), stress_type (default historical), stress_scenario, rate_shock_bp (bp, default 0), fx_shock_pct (%, default 0), credit_shock_bp (bp, default 0), volatility_shock_pct (%), correlation_shock (-1 to 1, default 0), historical_returns, lookback_period (days, default 250). Config: ce: apply_netting, apply_collateral, include_threshold; ee: method (monte_carlo|parametric), num_simulations, calculate_effective; eee: method (monte_carlo|parametric), num_simulations, calculate_effective; pfe: method (add_on|monte_carlo|parametric), num_simulations, time_horizon_years, confidence_pct; peak: method (ee_based|pfe_based), num_simulations; stressed: stress_type, default_scenario. Trades take the inputs of each product's qlrisk_price_<product> tool (rates in percent, spreads in basis points, maturity as a tenor like 5Y); confidence levels are in percent (99 = 99%). Inputs: trades, mode, measure, inputs; the rest (market_data, reporting_currency, history, config, time_horizon, num_scenarios, credit_factor, shock_sigmas, horizon_days, lookback, top_n, confidence_pct) in the optional `advanced` object. Example: {"trades": [{"product": "InterestRateSwap", "trade_id": "IRS-5Y", "maturity": "5Y", "notional": 10000000, "fixed_rate_pct": 4.4, "counterparty_id": "BANK-A"}], "mode": "trade_profiles"} gives Exposure profiles for 1 trade(s); largest peak PFE 623,804.12 on qlrisk's sample market valued 2026-10-09.
